name: Stream Bridge
author: Fraser Simpson
description: Stream and download tracks through Eclipse Music add-ons

actions.name: download.source
actions.why: Finds audio files for offline downloads

settings.label: Add-on 1 URL
settings.description: Eclipse add-on manifest URL, including any token path. Example: https://host.example/token/manifest.json

settings.label: Enable add-on 1
settings.description: Include this add-on in the playback fallback order.

settings.label: Test add-on 1
settings.description: Checks the manifest and performs a sample search. No audio is played.

settings.label: Add-on 2 URL
settings.description: Eclipse add-on manifest URL, including any token path. Example: https://host.example/token/manifest.json

settings.label: Enable add-on 2
settings.description: Include this add-on in the playback fallback order.

settings.label: Test add-on 2
settings.description: Checks the manifest and performs a sample search. No audio is played.

settings.label: Add-on 3 URL
settings.description: Eclipse add-on manifest URL, including any token path. Example: https://host.example/token/manifest.json

settings.label: Enable add-on 3
settings.description: Include this add-on in the playback fallback order.

settings.label: Test add-on 3
settings.description: Checks the manifest and performs a sample search. No audio is played.

settings.label: Try the next add-on on failure
settings.description: When enabled, continue down the configured add-on list if a provider is offline, has no match, or cannot return a playable stream.

settings.label: Strict track matching
settings.description: Require exact normalised title and artist matches. Disable only if your add-ons use inconsistent metadata.

settings.label: Duration tolerance
settings.description: Maximum duration difference accepted when both sides provide a duration.

settings.label: Diagnostic track title
settings.description: Track title used for the playback diagnostic.

settings.label: Diagnostic track artist
settings.description: Track artist used for the playback diagnostic.

settings.label: Diagnostic track ISRC (optional)
settings.description: Optional ISRC for exact recording matching.

settings.label: Diagnostic track duration (ms)
settings.description: Optional duration in milliseconds. Use 0 if unknown.

settings.label: Run diagnostics
settings.description: Check each enabled provider's manifest and search endpoint, and test the configured track.

settings.label: Test diagnostic track
settings.description: Try to resolve the configured track to a playable stream using provider fallback order.
